data.title: Wire ALLOWED_HOSTS to DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS env var

data.body:
Self-review (same independence caveat as HDT-2/HDT-3: session operator instruction forbids spawning sub-agents unless the user asks).

Acceptance criteria:
1. PASS - GET http://0.0.0.0:8000/ returns 200. Reported failure resolved.
2. PASS - 127.0.0.1 and localhost both still 200. No regression from replacing the implicit DEBUG list.
3. PASS - manage.py check clean.
4. PASS - curl -H 'Host: evil.example' returns 400. Setting is enforced, not accidentally widened to ['*'].
5. PASS - app/requirements.txt untouched.
Resolved value inside the container confirmed as ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0'].

Root-cause note for the record: HDT-3's verification curled 127.0.0.1 only, which the implicit DEBUG list already covers, so this gap survived that task's review. Host-header behaviour needs testing against the host actually used, not just any working host.

Remaining in settings.py, still unrequested: SECRET_KEY (ignores DJANGO_SECRET_KEY) and DEBUG (ignores DJANGO_DEBUG, hardcoded True). Ordering hazard: this fix is what prevents a blanket 400 once DEBUG is wired to DJANGO_DEBUG=0 - wiring DEBUG first would have taken the app down.
